item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 10
item.description: Qu Ji had transferred schools. Ji Yao heard this from Xu Xingxing, who was widely known as a well-connected know-it-all—he knew everything that happened in the entire school. Xu Xingxing also said that Qu Ji’s father had been arrested for hit-and-run, and Qu Ting had been taken in for malicious retaliation and involvement in a high-value theft. Xu Xingxing took a big gulp of water before continuing, “Their family really doesn’t have a single decent person. Qu Ji isn’t any good either. If he weren’t a minor, he’d have been taken in too. I heard his mother isn’t easy to get along with either. item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 9
item.description: With no classes on Sunday and his vocal teacher taking a leave, canceling the interest class, Ji Yao didn’t have to go anywhere. Yet, early in the morning, Xie Congxiao still pulled him out from under the blankets and carried him to the bathroom to wash up. Ji Yao was so sleepy he couldn’t open his eyes. He opened his mouth and let his brother brush his teeth for him, listening to Xie Congxiao’s gentle voice beside his ear: “You can go back to sleep after breakfast.” After rinsing his mouth, Ji Yao buried his face in Xie Congxiao’s chest, mumbling, “I’m not hungry yet. item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 8
item.description: Ji Yao suddenly found the ice cream in his hand tasteless. The person who had arrived was the boy who had called Xie Congxiao earlier, and Ji Yao recognized his voice. "What a coincidence, you guys came here to play too?" The boy's voice was pleasant and gentle. From the sound of it, he seemed to be standing next to Xie Congxiao. Ji Yao picked at the ice cream wrapper, his good mood instantly vanishing. He didn't know why he felt so unhappy—he just didn't want his brother to be taken away, nor did he want his brother to date anyone. Xie Congxiao's attitude was indifferent: "You are?" item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 7
item.description: With Xie Congxiao’s fractured hand, Ji Yao had no extra energy to dwell on the matter with Qu Ji. Every day, he nervously took care of his brother. However, on the anniversary of their parents’ passing, Lin Jing paid a visit. Uncle Lin told them that the lawsuit was progressing smoothly and advised them not to worry. He also reminded Xie Congxiao to take good care of himself and Ji Yao, and to call him if they encountered any difficulties. Ji Yao felt somewhat confused listening to their conversation. He always felt that Xie Congxiao was hiding something from him, but he never managed to ask.
